name: How should I prepare my kitchen before drywall repair begins?

mainEntity.name: How should I prepare my kitchen before drywall repair begins?

acceptedAnswer.text: Before the drywall crew arrives, clear all countertops, empty nearby cabinets if wall studs will be exposed, and move freestanding kitchen islands or carts. Make sure the contractor has an unobstructed pathway from the home entry to the kitchen to carry full drywall sheets and compound buckets. If the repair is near your stove or refrigerator, discuss ahead of time whether appliances must be unplugged and pulled out. Also clarify who will handle floor protection and plastic containment barriers to keep fine drywall dust out of adjoining living spaces.
acceptedAnswer.description: Clear off countertops, empty cabinets near the repair area, create a clear path for moving drywall sheets, and clarify if appliances need to be pulled out before work starts.
